evidence.explanation: JS selectionPoint decodes numeric point storage in place of the C selection_getpoint calls in OR/subtraction. The four edges describe one helper-substitution cause, not four independent defects.
evidence.proof: Exact C OR/subtraction wrappers plus selection allocation/read/write/bounds and rect_bounds helpers match production JS exports for all64 overlap value pairs0..7 under each operator (128 comparisons) and all4 disjoint boolean pairs per operator (8 controls). Entire1680-byte maps and computed bounds agree. JS outputs are fresh, absolute and leave both inputs unchanged. Fixed two-selection Lua stack adapters; shared absolute frame only.
evidence.control: Disjoint boolean pairs distinguish overlap arithmetic from independent point retention, including empty operands/results; controls pass8 comparisons.
